title: Expose Payables Agent infotip sources through test fixtures
summary: Test fixtures for the Payables Agent now expose infotip sources and business context, allowing offline evaluations to collect explanations without directly depending on E-Document apps. The change provides source descriptors through internal test APIs only.
key_points: Expose version-neutral source records through PA Test Fixtures for infotip collection
Support both V1 discovery in draft-based compatibility code and V2 native purchase-document outcomes
Infotip schema includes record ID, description, field explanations, confidence levels, and optional references
Internal TestSupport API only; no production changes or public API modifications
Includes new tests covering positive scenarios and negative cases for source discovery
